items.title: File Clark County business personal property return
items.description: Nevada business personal property declarations are due to the county assessor by July 31 (or 15 days after a county demand if later), even when the business has no assets.

items.title: File the Clark County transient lodging tax return
items.description: Combined transient lodging (room tax) returns are monthly and officially due on the first of the month after the reporting month, but count as on time if received or postmarked by the 15th. Late returns bear interest and additional fees. Questions: Audit Division, (702) 455-6121.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: Get and renew the Clark County food establishment health permit
items.description: Plan review is required before construction or remodeling; apply at least 30 days before opening to avoid late fees, and applying after a change of ownership by more than 30 days also costs extra. Plan review fees are non-refundable and cover up to two site visits; a final inspection must pass before stocking food or opening.

items.title: File Washoe County business personal property return
items.description: Nevada business personal property declarations are due to the county assessor by July 31 (or 15 days after a county demand if later), even when the business has no assets. Declarations are filed through the county's online e-Dec system.

note: Washoe County's transient lodging tax is 3% of gross receipts under a 1999 act of the legislature, but its return due date and registration steps were not found.
